timeline.summary: Transformers And Rectifiers (India) Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.25 per equity share on April 21, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
2026-04-21: Q4/FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 consolidated revenue ₹2,509 Cr (+24.2%), PAT ₹272 Cr (+25.6%), order book ₹5,005 Cr and ₹600 Cr capex plan.
Transformers And Rectifiers (India) Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 31 March 2026.
Transformers And Rectifiers (India) Limited’s **Rakesh Kiri** shared the Q4 FY2025-26 earnings conference call audio recording on 2026-04-21.
TARIL reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹2,395 Cr (+23% YoY) and PAT of ₹225 Cr, backed by an order book of ₹5,005 Cr.
TARIL won a USD 16,258,352 (≈₹150 Cr) export order from AK LPIV, LLC for 5 transformers, to be delivered by mid-2027.
Transformers And Rectifiers reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,509 Cr and PAT of ₹272 Cr with an order book of ₹5,005 Cr.
Transformers And Rectifiers secured a domestic order of ₹175 crore from Bhanwariya Infra Projects for transformers and reactors to be delivered by March 2028.
Transformers And Rectifiers secured a ₹228.26 crore domestic order from GETCO for transformers and reactors, to be delivered by August 2028.

2026-05-23: Shareholders passed the special resolution re-appointing Rajendra S. Shah as Independent Director for a second term (2026-2031) with 92.61% of votes polled in favour, while 70.62% of public institution votes were against.
On 21 July 2026, TARIL held its Q1FY27 earnings call, guiding 25% FY27 revenue growth and 16% standalone EBITDA margin, with an unexecuted order book of ₹6,630 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹739.44 Cr (+60.7% YoY), net profit ₹81.38 Cr (+117.9% YoY).

2026-10-13: TARIL's Q2FY27 investor presentation showed consolidated revenue ₹739.44 Cr (+61% YoY), EBITDA margin 17.4%, PAT ₹81.28 Cr (+117%), and an unexecuted order book of ₹7,237 Cr; FY27 guidance reiterated.
Rakesh Kiri, Company Secretary, disclosed the earnings conference call recording on 13th October 2026 for Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 results.

On 13 October 2026, TARIL's Q2FY27 call reported standalone revenue of ₹709 Cr (up 66% YoY) at a 16.1% EBITDA margin, an unexecuted order book of ₹7,237 Cr and working capital of 154 days, with FY27 guidance maintained.
